newsitem.title: CANADA: Alliance Forest, Kimberly-Clark sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Forest, Kimberly-Clark sign agreement.

text.p: Alliance Forest Products Inc and Kimberly-Clark Corp said on Friday they have signed an asset purchase agreement for Alliance's acquisition of Kimberly-Clark's Coosa Pines facilities for about US$600 million.
The acquisition, which was announced on December 16, will be funded through a combination of debt and equity, the companies said in a statement.
The transaction is expected to close toward the end of the first quarter of 1997.
The companies also agreed to a five-year supply contract under which Kimberly-Clark will purchase a significant portion of the pulp produced at Coosa Pines.
The facilities include a fully integrated paper mill which produces 308,000 tonnes of newsprint and 85,200 tonnes of groundwood printing paper a year.

In addition to fulfilling its internal pulp requirements, Coosa Pines' produces 222,000 tonnes of fluff pulp and 50,000 tonnes of Southern Bleached Hardwood Kraft pulp. The facilities also include 146,000 hectares of timberland and a sawmill with a production capacity of 51 million fbm.
